answer: Duplicate identities mandate replaying that entire costly chain, since fresh keys start at zero reputation. Each agent must stake a signed quill-marked provenance log sealed at a karst checkpoint, binding identity to verifiable work history. Attacker costs scale with forging distinct histories, not just keys, pushing the sybil horizon far beyond cheap mass registration and making spam fleets economically irrational. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
